00089 UGen::UGen(UGenInternal* internalUGenToUse, const int channel) throw()
00090 : userData(UGen::defaultUserData),
00091   numInternalUGens(0),
00092   internalUGens(0)  
00093 {
00094   ugen_assert(internalUGenToUse != 0);
00095   
00096   initInternal(1);
00097     
00098   if(channel >= 0)
00099   {
00100     UGenInternal* internaUGenChannel = internalUGenToUse->getChannelInternal(channel);
00101     internalUGenToUse->decrementRefCount();
00102     internalUGenToUse = internaUGenChannel;
00103   }
00104   
00105   internalUGens[0] = internalUGenToUse;
00106 }

00427 void UGen::constructMultichannel(const int numUGens, const UGen uGenArray[]) throw()
00428 {
00429   if(uGenArray == 0)
00430   {
00431     initInternal(numUGens);
00432     for(int i = 0; i < numUGens; i++)
00433     {
00434       internalUGens[i] = getNullInternal();
00435     }
00436   }
00437   else
00438   {
00439     int totalChannels = 0;
00440     
00441     for(int uGenIndex = 0; uGenIndex < numUGens; uGenIndex++)
00442     {
00443       totalChannels += uGenArray[uGenIndex].numInternalUGens;
00444     }
00445     
00446     initInternal(totalChannels);
00447     
00448     int channel = 0;
00449     
00450     for(int uGenIndex = 0; uGenIndex < numUGens; uGenIndex++)
00451     {
00452       for(int internalIndex = 0; internalIndex < uGenArray[uGenIndex].numInternalUGens; internalIndex++)
00453       {     
00454         // was: internalUGens[channel++] = uGenArray[uGenIndex].getInternalUGen(internalIndex);
00455         internalUGens[channel++] = uGenArray[uGenIndex].getChannel(internalIndex).getInternalUGen(0);
00456       }
00457     }
00458   }
00459 }

00609 UGen UGen::expand() const throw()
00610 {
00611   UGen newUGen;
00612   
00613   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00614   {
00615     newUGen <<= UGen(getInternalUGen(i), i);
00616   }
00617   
00618   newUGen.userData = userData;
00619   
00620   return newUGen;
00621 }

00633 UGen UGen::at(const int index) const throw()
00634 { 
00635   if(index < 0 || index >= numInternalUGens)
00636   {
00637     ugen_assertfalse;
00638     return getNull();
00639   }
00640   else
00641     return UGen(getInternalUGen(index), index);
00642 }

00644 UGen UGen::at(IntArray const& indices) const throw()
00645 { 
00646   const int numChannels = indices.length();
00647   
00648   if(numChannels == 0)
00649   {
00650     ugen_assertfalse;
00651     return getNull();
00652   }
00653   else
00654   {
00655     UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numChannels];
00656     
00657     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00658     {
00659       const int index = indices[channel];
00660       
00661       if(index < 0 || index >= numInternalUGens) 
00662         newInternals[channel] = getNullInternal();
00663       else
00664         newInternals[channel] = getInternalUGen(index);
00665     }
00666     
00667     return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00668   }
00669 }

00672 UGen UGen::wrapAt(const int index) const throw()
00673 { 
00674   int indexToUse = index;
00675   while(indexToUse < 0) indexToUse += numInternalUGens;
00676   
00677   return at(indexToUse % numInternalUGens);

00694     {
00695       int index = indices[channel];
00696       while(index < 0) index += numInternalUGens;
00697       
00698       newInternals[channel] = getInternalUGen(index % numInternalUGens);
00699     }
00700     
00701     return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00702   }
00703 }
00704 
00705 UGen UGen::range(const int startIndex, const int endIndex) const throw()
00706 {
00707   ugen_assert(startIndex >= 0);
00708   ugen_assert(endIndex < numInternalUGens);
00709   ugen_assert(startIndex < endIndex);
00710   
00711   const int startIndexChecked = clip(startIndex, 0, numInternalUGens);
00712   const int endIndexChecked = clip(endIndex, 0, numInternalUGens);
00713   
00714   const int numChannels = endIndexChecked - startIndexChecked;
00715   
00716   if(numChannels <= 0)
00717   {
00718     ugen_assertfalse;
00719     return getNull();
00720   }
00721   else
00722   {
00723     UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numChannels];
00724     
00725     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00726     {
00727       newInternals[i] = getInternalUGen(i + startIndexChecked);
00728     }
00729     
00730     return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00731   }
00732 }
00733 
00734 UGen UGen::from(const int startIndex) const throw()
00735 {
00736   return range(startIndex);
00737 }
00738 
00739 UGen UGen::range(const int startIndex) const throw()
00740 {
00741   return range(startIndex, 0x7fffffff);
00742 }
00743 
00744 UGen UGen::to(const int endIndex) const throw()
00745 {
00746   return range(0, endIndex);
00747 }

00749 void UGen::initInternal(const int numInternalUGensToInit) throw()
00750 {
00751   // could optimise here if the new size is less than the current size and not realloc...?
00752   
00753   ugen_assert(numInternalUGensToInit > 0);
00754   
00755   if((numInternalUGens > 0) && (internalUGens != 0))
00756   {
00757     decrementInternals();
00758     delete [] internalUGens;
00759   }
00760   
00761   numInternalUGens = numInternalUGensToInit;
00762   internalUGens = (numInternalUGens > 0)
00763           ? new UGenInternal*[numInternalUGens]
00764           : 0;
00765 }

00783 UGen UGen::withNumChannels(const int numChannels, const bool addedChannelsWrap) const throw()
00784 {
00785   UGenInternal** newInternals = new UGenInternal*[numChannels];
00786   
00787   if(addedChannelsWrap || (numChannels <= numInternalUGens))
00788   {
00789     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00790     {
00791       newInternals[i] = getInternalUGen(i % numInternalUGens);
00792     }
00793   }
00794   else
00795   {
00796     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00797     {
00798       newInternals[i] = getInternalUGen(i);
00799     }
00800     
00801     for(int i = numInternalUGens; i < numChannels; i++)
00802     {
00803       newInternals[i] = getNullInternal();
00804     }
00805   }
00806   
00807   return UGen(numChannels, newInternals);
00808 }

00873 bool UGen::containsIdenticalInternalsAs(UGen const& other, const bool mustBeInTheSameSequence) const throw()
00874 {
00875   if(numInternalUGens != other.numInternalUGens) 
00876     return false;
00877   
00878   if(mustBeInTheSameSequence == true)
00879   {
00880     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00881     {
00882       if(internalUGens[i] != other.internalUGens[i])
00883         return false;
00884     }
00885   }
00886   else
00887   {
00888     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00889     {
00890       bool foundMatch = false;
00891       
00892       for(int j = 0; j < other.numInternalUGens; j++)
00893       {
00894         if(internalUGens[i] == other.internalUGens[j])
00895         {
00896           foundMatch = true;
00897           break;
00898         }
00899       }
00900       
00901       if(foundMatch == false)
00902         return false;
00903     }
00904   }
00905   
00906   return true;
00907 }

00935 
00936 float* UGen::prepareAndProcessBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00937 {   
00938   if(channel < 0)
00939   {
00940     prepareForBlock(actualBlockSize, blockID, -1);
00941   }
00942   else
00943   {
00944     for(unsigned int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00945     {
00946       prepareForBlock(actualBlockSize, blockID, i);
00947     }   
00948   }
00949   
00950   bool shouldDelete = false;
00951   return processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00952 }
00953 
00954 
00955 float* UGen::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00956 {   
00957   ugen_assert(numInternalUGens > 0);
00958   ugen_assert(internalUGens != 0);
00959   
00960   if(channel < 0) 
00961   {
00962     // process all channels
00963     for(unsigned int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00964     {
00965       internalUGens[i]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, i);
00966     }
00967     
00968     return 0;
00969   } 
00970   else if(numInternalUGens == 1) 
00971   {
00972     float* block = internalUGens[0]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00973     return block;
00974   } 
00975   else if(numInternalUGens == 2) 
00976   {
00977     float* block = internalUGens[channel & 1]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00978     return block;
00979   }
00980   else 
00981   {
00982     unsigned int internalChannel = (unsigned int)channel % numInternalUGens;    
00983     float* block = internalUGens[internalChannel]->processBlockInternal(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00984     return block;
00985   }
00986   
00987 }
00988  
00989 void UGen::prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00990 { 
00991   ugen_assert(actualBlockSize > 0);
00992   ugen_assert(numInternalUGens > 0);
00993   ugen_assert(internalUGens != 0);
00994   
00995   bool shouldDelete = false;
00996   
00997   if(channel < 0)
00998   {
00999     for(unsigned int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++) 
01000     {
01001       if(internalUGens[i]->shouldBeDeletedNow(blockID)) {
01002         shouldDelete = true;
01003         break;
01004       }
01005     }
01006     
01007     if(shouldDelete) 
01008     {
01009       for(unsigned int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01010       { 
01011         internalUGens[i]->userData = userData;
01012         internalUGens[i]->decrementRefCount();
01013       }
01014       
01015       numInternalUGens = 1;
01016       internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();
01017       internalUGens[0]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID, 0);   
01018     } 
01019     else 
01020     {
01021       for(unsigned int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01022       {
01023         internalUGens[i]->userData = userData;
01024         internalUGens[i]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID, i);
01025       }
01026     }
01027   }
01028   else if((unsigned int)channel < numInternalUGens)
01029   {
01030     bool shouldDelete = internalUGens[channel]->shouldBeDeletedNow(blockID);
01031     
01032     if(shouldDelete) 
01033     {
01034       for(unsigned int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01035       { 
01036         internalUGens[i]->userData = userData;
01037         internalUGens[i]->decrementRefCount();
01038       }
01039       
01040       numInternalUGens = 1;
01041       internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();
01042       internalUGens[0]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID, 0);   
01043     } 
01044     else 
01045     {
01046       internalUGens[channel]->userData = userData;
01047       internalUGens[channel]->prepareForBlockInternal(actualBlockSize, blockID, channel);
01048     }   
01049   }
01050 }

01209 void UGen::steal(const bool forcedSteal) throw()
01210 {
01211   if(forcedSteal == true)
01212   {
01213     // just dispose the current UGens and set them to null
01214     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01215     {
01216       internalUGens[i]->decrementRefCount();
01217       internalUGens[i] = getNullInternal();
01218     }
01219   }
01220   else
01221   {
01222     // allow the UGens to handle stealing more gracefully
01223     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01224     {
01225       internalUGens[i]->stealInternal();
01226     }   
01227   }
01228 }

01597 UGenArray UGen::group(const int size) const throw()
01598 {
01599   ugen_assert(size > 0);
01600   
01601   int outputSize = numInternalUGens / size;
01602   if(numInternalUGens % size != 0) outputSize++;
01603   
01604   UGenArray array(outputSize);
01605   
01606   int inputIndex = 0;
01607   
01608   for(int outputIndex = 0; outputIndex < outputSize; outputIndex++)
01609   {
01610     UGen item;
01611     
01612     for(int i = 0; i < size && inputIndex < numInternalUGens; i++, inputIndex++)
01613     {
01614       item <<= operator[] (inputIndex);
01615     }
01616     
01617     array.put(outputIndex, item);
01618   }
01619   
01620   return array;
01621 }

01630   {
01631     UGen item;

01633     for(int inputIndex = outputIndex; inputIndex < numInternalUGens; inputIndex += size)
01634     {
01635       item <<= operator[] (inputIndex);
01636     }
01637     
01638     array.put(outputIndex, item);
01639   }
01640   
01641   return array;

01678 UGen UGen::interleave(UGen const& rightOperand) const throw()
01679 {
01680   // need to check this...
01681   
01682   if(rightOperand.isNull())
01683     return *this;
01684   else if(isNull())
01685     return rightOperand;
01686   else
01687   {
01688     UGen interleavedChannels;
01689     int maxNumChannels;
01690     if(numInternalUGens > rightOperand.numInternalUGens)
01691       maxNumChannels = numInternalUGens;
01692     else
01693       maxNumChannels = rightOperand.numInternalUGens;
01694     
01695     for(int i = 0; i < maxNumChannels; i++)
01696     {
01697       interleavedChannels <<= wrapAt(i);
01698       interleavedChannels <<= rightOperand.wrapAt(i);
01699     }
01700     
01701     return interleavedChannels;
01702   }
01703 }

01822 UGen UGen::kr() const throw()
01823 {

01827     return UGen(newInternal);
01828   }
01829   else
01830   {

01832     
01833     for(unsigned int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
01834     {
01835       newInternals[i] = internalUGens[i]->getKr();
01836     }
01837     
01838     UGen newUGen = UGen((int)numInternalUGens, newInternals);
01839         
01840     delete [] newInternals;
01841     
01842     return newUGen;
01843   }
01844 }
